name: activate-trial
description: Activate the 14-day business trial on a workspace. Requires an active Notion session AND an hCaptcha P1_... token (obtained manually from a real browser session: open Notion → Settings → Billing → Start free trial → devtools Network tab → copy the captchaToken from the updateSubscription request body). The token is short-lived (~2 min). Matches HAR Phase F step 18.

steps.function: (args) => { const trialEnd = new Date(Date.now() + (args.trialDays || 14) * 86400000).toISOString(); return { modalSessionId: crypto.randomUUID(), trialEnd }; }

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); if (d.subscriptionStatus === 'trialing') return { ok: true, status: d.subscriptionStatus, invoiceUrl: d.invoiceUrl || '' }; return { ok: false, status: d.subscriptionStatus || 'unknown', body: args.body.slice(0, 300) }; } catch(e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }
